paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa a-inn a om a, TOUPA'N akimvel a melmate tengteng a pan galmuang a a-omsak nung in;
heading: David Kiang A Nathan Thugen / (1 Kro 17.1-15)

paite: Kumpipa'n zawlnei Nathan kiang ah, "Tu in en in kei sidar sing inn ah ka teng a, himahleh Pathian bawm puanin ah a-om,” achi hi.
Nathan in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in va hih in, na kiang ah TOUPA a-om hi," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan mah in Nathan kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
"Ka sikha David va hilh in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ka tenna ding inn na hon lamsak ding maw?' "
Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak a pan tuni tan in inn ah ka teng kei a, puanin ah leh biakbuk ah ka teng zaw hi.
Israel suante lak a ka paina tengteng ah leng, ka mi Israel vak dia thu ka piak vaihawmte kiang ah, "Bangziak a sidar sing a inn hon lamsak lou?" chi in ka gen ngei a hia?
Huaiziak in ka sikha David kiang ah, sepaihte! TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Belam tatna mun a pan belam na ven lai in ka mi Israel mite tung a heutu ding in ka hon la hi.
Na hohna peuh ah na kiang ah ka om zel a, na ma ah na melmate ka hihmang zel hi. Lei a mithupitakte bang in min thupitak ka hon bawlsak hi.
Hiai ban ah ka mi Israelte a ding in mun ka sep dia, amau ka suan ding a, amau mun mah ah ateng ding ua, tuma lam bang in gitlouhna tate'n ahihbuai nawn kei ding uh.
Na melmate tengteng lak a pan ka hon khawlsak hi. Huai lou him in TOUPA'N inn ka hon bawlsak ding, chi in ahon hilh hi.
Na ni abei a na pute kiang a na lup chiang in, na nung a na suan na gil a gah ding ka tungding ding a, agam ka hihkip ding.
Ama'n ka min a ding in inn alam dia, agam laltutphah tangtawn a ding in ka hihkip ding.
Apa ka hi ding a, amah ka tapa ahi ding. Thil ahihkhelhleh, mihing chiang leh mihing tapate khetna in ka thunun ding.
Himahleh, na ma a ka suanmang Saul kiang a pan ka lakmang bang in ka zahngaihna in ahon paisan kei ding hi.
Na inkuan leh na gam tangtawn a hihkip ngiungeu ahi dia, na laltutphah lah tangtawn in hihkip ahi ding," chi in.
Huai thute tengteng bang zel leh huai kilakna bang geih in Nathan in David kiang ah agen hi.
Huchi in kumpipa David alut a, TOUPA ma ah atu hi, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, kua ahia ka hih a, ka inkuante bang ahia ahih uh, hiai tantan na hon pi?
heading: David Kipahthugen Thumna / (1 Kro 17.16-27)

paite: Toupa PATHIAN aw, huaite leng nang mitmuh in thil bangmah tham ahi kei uh. Himahleh na sikha inkuan omdan ding thu kum tampi sung a ding in leng na gen khinta hi. Toupa PATHIAN aw, hiaite mihing hihdan ahi a hia?
David in na kiang ah bang agen nawn tuan dia? Toupa PATHIAN aw, na sikha lah na thei vek ngal a.
Na sikha theih ding in na thu ziak leh nangmah lungtang bang zel in hiai thil thupi tengteng na hihta hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA Pathian aw, nang na thupi hi. Ka bil ua ka zak bang un nang bang kuamah a-om kei a, nangmah lou ngal Pathian a-om kei hi,

Aigupta gam a pan leh namte leh apathiante ua pan tankhia a, min bawlsak ding leh na gam a dia na mite ma a thil thupitak leh thil lauhuaitak hih ding na mi Israelte bang leitung ah namdang kua a-om a?
Huchi in Israel mite tangtawn a na mite ahong hihtheihna ding un nang a ding in na hihkipta hi. TOUPA, nang a Pathian uh na hong hita hi.
"Huchi in TOUPA Pathian aw, na sikha tungtang thu leh a-inkuante tungtang thu na gen tangtawn a ding in hihkip inla, na gensa bang in hih in.
Sepaihte' TOUPA Israelte' Pathian ahi, chi in na min tangtawn in pahtawi in om hen. Huchi in na sikha David inkuante na ma ah hihkip in a-om ding uhi.
Sepaihte' TOUPA aw, Israel Pathian, na sikha kiang ah, inkuan ka hon phuhsak ding, chi in lah na puangta ngal a. Huaiziak in na sikha in hiai thumna na kiang ka hon tun ngam hi.
"Tu in Toupa PATHIAN aw, nang huai Pathian na hi a, na thu dik hen, hiai thil hoih na sikha kiang ah na chiamta hi.

Huaiziak in tu in na sikha inkuante na ma a tangtawn a a-om gige theihna ding un vualzawl in. Toupa PATHIAN aw, nang lah na genta ngal a. Na vualzawlna in na sikha inkuante tangtawn in vualzawl in om uhen," achi hi.
